scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run soak && npm run build && npm run api-fresh && npm run e2e && npm run safe-area && npm run release-check
scripts.api-fresh: git diff --quiet -- api/leaderboard.js || (echo "api/leaderboard.js is stale: the server would re-simulate scores with old rules. Commit the rebuilt bundle." && exit 1)
scripts.release-check: node tools/build-api.mjs && vite build --outDir dist-release --emptyOutDir && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const hits=fs.readdirSync('dist-release/assets').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')&&fs.readFileSync('dist-release/assets/'+f,'utf8').includes('__GAME'));if(hits.length){console.error('release build ships __GAME:',hits);process.exit(1)}console.log('release-check OK: no __GAME in the public build')"
